test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 10 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Ramali Bin Ibrahim, a Malaysian choreographer of Bharatanatyam and Odissi dance forms of India, received the Padma Shri in which of the following years?
solution:
The correct answer is **__2018.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Datuk Ramli bin Ibrahim is a Malaysian choreographer and a **classical ballet dancer.**
 
• In **2018**, the Government of India gave him Padma Shri for his contribution to the Odissi dance form.
 
• He was the student of another renowned **guru Adyar Lakshaman of Bharatnatyam.**
 
• In 2007 he set up the Sutra f**oundation in Malaysia.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Ramli was among 10 non-Indian nationals to receive the prestigious award in conjunction with India's Republic Day, which is celebrated then.
 
• **Padma Shri award:**
 
 
• **​__**The Padma Awards are **one of the highest civilian honours of India announced annually on the eve of Republic Day**.
 
• The Awards are given in three categories: Padma Vibhushan (for exceptional and distinguished service), Padma Bhushan (distinguished service of higher order) and Padma Shri (distinguished service).
 
• Padma Shri also spelt Padma Shree, is the fourth-highest civilian award of the Republic of India, after the Bharat Ratna, the Padma Vibhushan, and the Padma Bhushan.
 
• **All persons without distinction of race, occupation, position or sex** are eligible for these Awards.
